assertions: Actual reference-list constructor/default/copy/move/Clone preserve value-owned list elements and stable collection identity.
Original list identity equality is retained, including unequal distinct copies with equal values.
Original structured-table Item flags/UInt16 index/current area setters and getters preserve retained token identity.
Table copy/Clone clones actual area token; equality uses original base/index/item/null/payload checks.

stackDivergence.rationale: Task96 ports complete original ScRefListToken and ScTableRefToken constructors/defaults/copies/Clone/getters/mutators/equality using existing shared FormulaToken and real reference data. Reference responsibility moves unchanged task95 single/double/helper implementation into token.references.ts because adding complete original list/table families exceeds enforced500line token.ts limit; canonical token.ts/header exports retained and explicit responsibility-split provenance records added. RefList owns initialized value arrays: native push_back(value) maps to push(new ScComplexRefData(value)); copy/Clone copies values, implicit move transfers initialized element identities while preserving and emptying the source list owner. No generic vector/memory/refcount/pool/finalizer library. RefList compares collection-object identity, so distinct copies/clones compare unequal (CALC-085). Table UInt16 index/original Item masks/nullable genuine token RPN references are retained; copy/Clone clones area tokens and equality compares payloads. Ordinary JS references own areas; existing SAL/SVL boundary unchanged. Complete original class definitions and methods over verified genuine reference/shared/header dependencies produce a full normal initialized native stream; native layout/count/memory/sanitizers/invalid casts/unsupported enum/uninitialized/whole QA excluded. Original structured-reference and reference-list array-result QA anchors are unexecuted document consumer context. Actual compiler/ScTokenArray/configuration/ScFormulaCell/document/grid/ODS remain prioritized pending owners; nextfull101 continues, pause after secondfull111/relevant repairs. Writer-only coverage remains separate.
